1003.n1: We sincerely hope you enjoy your trip!

1005.name: Shuri

1008.name: Corporal Wilson
1008.n0: I'm here selling food for pets!
1008.n1: Don't you need some food for your pet?

1009.name: Corporal Easy
1009.n0: Where did the Sergeant and Staff Sergeant go???
1009.n1: Eh...?? I don't think this is where I was supposed to land...
1009.d0: This is a strange place. It looks like an abandoned tower. Oh, I'm #b#p1009##k, member of the Alpha Platoon. We got into an accident mid-flight and made an emergency landing here, but I can't find the others. I'm pretty confident that they're all okay, though.
1009.d1: This is a strange place. It looks like an abandoned tower. Oh, I'm #b#p1009##k, member of the Alpha Platoon. We got into an accident mid-flight and made an emergency landing here, but I can't find the others. I'm pretty confident that they're all okay, though.

1010.name: Lisa
1010.n1: I'm worried that monsters these days are much more ferocious...
1010.d1: Lately I've been concerned about a bunch of aggressive monsters that may hurt me a great deal...

1011.name: Trina
1011.n0: You need a place to store your mesos and items? Look no further!
1011.n1: Don't worry, my storage is safe and secure.

1012.name: Neri the Fairy
1012.n0: You'll need a great weapon or two to survive here in Ossyria...
1012.n1: You can't fool this set of fairy eyes, so I suggest you don't think of stealing around here.
1012.c0: To make great weapons, I need great materials to start with...
1012.c1: It's been 150 years since I last saw Rowen from Ellinia... I wonder how he's doing...

1013.name: Nuri the Fairy
1013.n0: You may want to grab some armor before heading out of town...
1013.n1: I have many goods that are perfect for humans, so come check them out.
1013.c0: Monsters seem to be more ferocious these days... armor is definitely a must for each and every one of you travelers.

1014.name: Edel the Fairy
1014.n0: There's no telling when and where you may face a powerful monster! Potions are definitely a must for every traveler!
1014.n1: I also have various tasty dishes made by us fairies.
1014.c0: To make good potions like these, I need to go around from place to place everyday looking for only the finest ingredients available.
1014.c1: I'm sure the fairies at Ellinia are doing well... right?

1015.name: Kriel the Fairy
1015.n0: Humans are just so shameless these days... they ask for favors as if it's nothing.
1015.n1: Wow... We're really short-handed here. I'd better work harder.
1015.d0: Lately humans have been asking for favors as if it's nothing. If they think we fairies will say yes to their every demand, well they're WRONG! Anyway, what do you want from me?
1015.d1: Did #b#t4031051##k help you in any way, shape, or form? Anyway, that assistant of #p1023#... is she doing alright? If you ever see her again, then please say hi to her for me.

1016.name: Elma the Housekeeper
1016.n0: Where did my master go... sigh...
1016.n1: What's going to happen to my next paycheck if the master isn't coming back...
1016.d0: It's been months since she left out of the blue. I haven't had much work lately, so that's good, but I also haven't been paid in months because she's not here. I'm just worried someone else may take over this house and I may never get paid...
1016.d1: It looks like you've been looking for her too. Do you have any idea how this all happened? I wonder where she is.

1017.name: Neve
1017.n0: How about making a glove? I can take care of the rest...
1017.n1: You'll need a nice glove to handle your weapon better... how about making one here?

1018.name: Franz the Owner
1018.n0: Do you want plastic surgery? Let me help you out then...
1018.n1: There's nothing wrong with changing your face every once in a while...

1019.name: Riza the Assistant
1019.n0: You... look like someone that may need plastic surgery.
1019.n1: How about completely redoing your face with the most popular look these days?

1020.name: Mino the Owner
1020.n0: Welcome. Oh no... your hair's been through tough times, huh? It needs some treatment...
1020.n1: Would you like to have a soft, silky-smooth, beautiful hair? Then let me take care of you...
1020.s0: Oh... you aren't interested in me, by any chance, right?
1020.s1: It's a fact that you don't have much time to take care of your hair while on a journey.
1020.l0: The only way you can keep your hair in perfect condition is through continuous effort!
1020.l1: To keep your hair as beautiful as mine requires major, maaajor effort.

1021.name: Rinz the Assistant
1021.n0: Hello~! Thanks for visiting our hair salon!
1021.n1: I may not be as good as the owner, but... how about letting me take care of your hair still?
1021.s0: Do you want to know about the latest trends in hairstyle? I'll do it for you!
1021.s1: Fairies love beautiful things, so I'm thinking it may help you on your journey down the road to have beautiful looking hair.
1021.c0: Wow, the owner is still the best of the best at this!
1021.c1: Please don't just leave... check out the hairstyles available for a change...

1022.name: Romi
1022.n1: So you want the most popular skin color these days, right?
1022.s0: What's the popular skin-color at Victoria Island?
1022.s1: It's good to look healthy with a nicely-tanned skin.

1023.name: Spiruna
1023.n0: I'm working on important magic, so please don't bother me.
1023.n1: Kids these days... they just barge into someone else's home as if it's nothing...
1023.d0: I'm in the middle of very important work here so please don't bother me and leave this place. I can't concentrate when a stranger is around.
1023.d1: I'm in the middle of very important work here so please don't bother me and leave this place. I can't concentrate when a stranger is around.

1024.n0: Spiruna tends to get overly aggressive at times... but once you get to know her, she is really a nice person at heart.
1024.n1: I've been assisting Spiruna while working hard myself, but it hasn't been easy...
1024.d0: I'm #b#p1023##k's assistant. Please forgive me for not giving you my name. #p1023# has been busy working on a new, difficult spell, so she's quite edgy right now. Unless it's an urgent matter, I suggest you leave her alone.
1024.d1: I'm #b#p1023##k's assistant. Please forgive me for not giving you my name. #p1023# has been busy working on a new, difficult spell, so she's quite edgy right now. Unless it's an urgent matter, I suggest you leave her alone.

1025.name: Barun
1025.n0: I made these scrolls, so I can guarantee that these all work to perfection!
1025.n1: Making scrolls is even easier than hunting down slimes.

1026.name: Huckle
1026.n0: I've been in here for 30 years now...
1026.n1: I'm working on gathering up the materials for some spells.
1026.d0: It's been a while since I last saw a person here, a place far far away from humanity. I've been in need of help, and I'm glad to see you here.
1026.d1: You're the one that helped me gather up samples of the monsters. Thanks to you the research has picked up steam, but honestly, I can use some more samples. If you see me by the time I run out of these samples, who knows, I may ask you for more.

1030.name: Heracle
1030.s0: Do you want to form a guild?
1030.s1: Only the strong and the brave should come talk to me.

1100.name: Master Sergeant Fox
1100.n0: Arrgh... WHERE DID MY MEN GO?!?!
1100.n1: I need to find them fast... hey you! Can you help me out here?
1100.d0: Because of an accident, all my men have been separated and spread out everywhere. I hope they're alright.
1100.d1: Oh... thanks for locating all my men for me the other day. Have you ever run into any one of them since? If not, then you should go see them. They may ask you for some help.

1101.name: Sergeant Bravo
1101.n0: Where is this? Where's Master Sergeant Fox?
1101.n1: Ahh... it's cold here... but I can't be stopped!!
1101.d0: It's so cold around here! I'm #b#p1101##k, member of the Alpha Platoon. We got on an accident in mid-flight and made an emergency landing here, but I can't find the others. I'm pretty confident that they're all okay, though.
1101.d1: Did you get #b#t4031095##k to #b#p1100##k? Do I need anything? Well, not for now. But come see me later, alright?

1102.name: Jade
1102.n0: An old friend of mine is suddenly nowhere to be found... I wonder how she's doing these days...
1102.n1: I've been investigating around this town lately and found some very interesting facts in the process...
1102.d0: I've been studying the geography of this island for a long time, and I still don't know a lot of things. I need more data. Anyway, I'm worried about this friend of mine in #m20000000# who disappeared out of the blue one day. I wonder what happened to her.
1102.d1: I have no clue where Hella may be, or what she is doing, but I'm sure she's doing just fine there. I'll be here living just fine, waiting for the day when I see her again.

1103.name: Scadur
1103.n0: Hey, back in the day, I could have taken down some Yetis if I felt like it...
1103.n1: The hunting hasn't been easy these days... those monsters out there got pretty ferocious...
1103.d0: Monsters have been getting much more ferocious lately. It's gotten to the point where I am worried about getting killed out there. I used to go hunt down a number of #o1068#s a day, but those days are now over. I'm old.
1103.d1: Monsters have been getting much more ferocious lately. It's gotten to the point where I am worried about getting killed out there. I used to go hunt down a number of #o1068#s a day, but those days are now over. I'm old.

1104.name: Tylus
1104.n0: Do you want to be a more powerful warrior than you ever were?
1104.n1: This is a sacred ground, so please try to stay calm.
1104.d0: Only the strongest of the strong deserves to move up the ladder and make the job advancement.
1104.d1: I can literally feel your strength exude through your body.

1105.name: Robeira
1105.n0: You'll need to see me in order to become the best magician in the world.
1105.d0: Only those that seek to further probe into the truth deserve to make the job advancement.
1105.d1: I can feel your thirst for more truth just by looking at your eyes.

1106.name: Rene
1106.n0: The path of the bowman is long and treacherous.
1106.n1: Please be quiet so we can concentrate on our work here.
1106.d0: Only those with the eyes that look through the truth deserve to make the job advancement.
1106.d1: I can grasp what kind of truth you seek through those eyes of yours.

1107.name: Arec
1107.n0: You want to become a powerful thief? Then you've come to the right person.
1107.n1: Please try not to make any noise around here.
1107.d0: Only the ones that seek to seek further into darkness deserve to make the job advancement.
1107.d1: I can clearly see the darkness in you.

1108.name: Vogen
1108.n0: If you have any raw ores of minerals or jewels, you should let me take care of the rest...
1108.n1: I've been handling various ores for decades now... so long, that I can refine them with my eyes closed...

1109.name: Gordon
1109.n0: Hey there! Your shoes look worn out... how about trying on MY pair of shoes?
1109.n1: I have been making shoes in this town for over 50 years now... hahah...

1110.name: Mr. Thalj
1110.n0: You need a place to store your items and mesos? Then you came to the right place.
1110.n1: My storage is safe and secure, so no worries!

1111.name: Alcaster
1111.n0: Hmmm... another new set of data... the more I work on it, the more it seems to never end...
1111.n1: I found something very interesting, but it's not something I can work on just by myself...
1111.d0: I'm #p1111# the sorcerer, and I've been working on various spells and magic here for over 300 years.
1111.d1: Hey, how have you been? Thanks to you, I can now live out the remaining days of my life in peace. All I want to do now is just study things in life.

1112.name: Scott
1112.n0: You won't find these weapons anywhere else... haha.
1112.n1: Our weapon store only deals in the finest weapons around...

1113.name: Rumi

1113.n1: Without armor, you may run into some trouble against monsters... so take a look around and see if you like anything.

1114.name: Hana

1114.n1: Welcome~! Whatever you may need for your journey, I have it all.

1115.name: Jeff
1115.n0: Don't even think about entering here... it's not some place where anyone can just waltz in...
1115.n1: Only the strongest can enter here... if you want in, talk to me.

1116.name: Glibber

1119.name: Ali
1119.n0: The only way out is to talk to me.
1119.n1: If you want out, talk to me.

1120.name: Aura

1121.name: Lira
